title: How paqad obtains the output of a project command the site map needs
context: The site map sometimes needs the output of a project introspection command (e.g. php artisan route:list) because the real router resolves modular routes, middleware and controllers a static scan cannot. Option run: paqad executes the read-only command itself, in-session, detecting the stack from the dependency manifest and invoking the matching read-only command via execa with a 20s timeout; on failure it degrades to a static scan and records a blocked check with the reason and fix. Option print: paqad prints the command and waits for the human to paste the output. Recommendation: run (read-only commands only), with print-and-paste kept only as a last-resort tray fallback when the command cannot run.

rationale: Confirmed by Haider: paqad runs read-only introspection commands itself in-session (stack detected from the dependency manifest, invoked via execa with a 20s timeout). On failure it degrades to a static scan and records a blocked check with the reason and fix. Print-and-paste is kept only as a last-resort fallback, never the primary path.
